results.title: GomSpace A/S: Q2 Financial Reporting Confirms a Strong First Half of 2026: 30% Growth, Positive EBIT, Reinforced Balance Sheet and Guidance Maintained
results.description: STOCKHOLM, Aug. 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- GomSpace posts above-market 30% revenue growth, improved profitability with 11% EBITDA and positive EBIT, and a strengthened balance sheet with equity ratio increase to 41%, while progressing its shift toward sovereign solutions and long-term value...
